subject: physics
question: What will happen to the object when it is released from the circular path?
note: Simulate circular motion in a frictionless environment.

options.label: It flew straight out along the line of the string.
It flew off in a straight line along the tangent — the way it was already going.
It kept following the circle, as if the string were still there.
It spiralled outward, partly along the string and partly across it.

explain: The object flies off along the tangent because it has only radial velocity at the point of release.
